name: Multilingual eval v1
description: Runs all 80 items of eval-multilingual-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Rows use three scorers: contains for translations (with any-of alternative lists), mc for comprehension, numeric for the word problems.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
